definitions.ask: Should Ctrl+N / Ctrl+P also step between fields when no stage is open (browse mode)?
definitions.why: One rule (Ctrl+N/P = ↓/↑ wherever arrows move) matches Bob's other pickers

choices.label: Ctrl+N/P also move the field selection in browse; a full ↓/↑ synonym on the card
Ctrl+N/P move only picker highlights; browse keeps j/k, arrows, and Tab
